clue.text: Disappointment hit home, leaving yours truly a little sad

taken as written
yours truly is the setter, ME, and it is removed
first letter of sad

explanation.surface: Someone lands a blow on their own house and is left feeling slightly glum and let down.
explanation.walkthrough: BAT + HO(ME) with ME dropped + S gives BATHOS.
explanation.definitionFit: Bathos is an anticlimax, a ludicrous descent from the lofty to the trivial, hence a disappointment.

clue.text: Playwright in ocean indeed a criminal from the south

the first letter of the name

clue.text: Experience an early spring travelling down the lane?
